title: 5 Foods You Should Always Buy Organic And Why!
summary: Plant-based creator's list of foods to always buy organic (oats, chickpeas, strawberries, spinach, tofu), driven by glyphosate and residue concerns, with a baking-soda wash tip for conventional produce.

verdicts.note: The USDA National List allows some synthetic substances such as certain insecticidal soaps, horticultural oils and copper compounds.
The review states organic standards prohibit synthetic chemical crop protection products (a background statement on EU-style standards, not a survey of the US National List exceptions).
EU organic rules allow two synthetic pyrethroids, lambda-cyhalothrin and deltamethrin, though only in insect traps; EU-specific.

7 CFR 205.601 lists synthetic substances allowed in organic crop production, among them insecticides (insecticidal soaps, horticultural oils, lime sulfur), copper fungicides and a rodenticide, usually only after preventive practices fail; so not all synthetic pesticides are banned.

Annex I of EU Regulation 2021/1165 authorises plant protection active substances for organic production including paraffin oils, lime sulphur, copper hydroxide, copper oxychloride, Bordeaux mixture and the synthetic pyrethroids deltamethrin and lambda-cyhalothrin (in traps only), so EU organic rules do not ban all synthetic pesticides.

verdicts.note: Some organic-approved pesticides such as copper sulfate are as or more toxic per application than common synthetic alternatives.
